evidence_slice: Lambeth Council's current Site Allocations Development Plan Document page states that the council received the Inspector's Report on 3 March 2026 and that the SADPD contains site-specific planning policies for 13 sites proposed for allocation. The Inspector's Final Report identifies Brixton Proposed Site Allocation Site 17, 330-336 Brixton Road, as a new allocation; the site is 0.52 hectares in mixed private ownership, with Nos. 332-334 Brixton Road owned by the South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust. The current council page describes the SADPD as not yet adopted.
